improvedVsOld: Clearly better overall. The new text reads like native travel writing: idioms such as 'chi prima arriva, meglio alloggia', 'piano B', 'in un’area di sosta si sosta, non si campeggia' and 'non è speculazione: sono semplicemente i conti' fit naturally. Glossary terms are applied consistently: collezioni (not raccolte), aree gratuite / campeggio libero (not soste gratuite), piazzola, punto di scarico, station dell’outback, Total Fire Ban glossed. Agencies get first-use glosses: Parks Victoria, VicEmergency, CFA, Parks and Wildlife/DBCA, shire, roadhouse, showground, honesty box. The new text also removes a banned offline-map claim: old ui.metaKeywords had 'mappa campeggi offline Australia', new has 'app campeggi offline Australia'. All remaining 'offline' mentions refer to place details, which mirrors the English and the style guide allows. Automated checks found no em dashes, no straight apostrophes, all placeholders and markup intact, and all numbers, AUD figures and dates preserved. Prices are formatted per the guide (80-140 A$). Grocery sections[6].body[0] writes '100-170 dollari' for the English 'a hundred to a hundred and seventy dollars', which is correct. Two small regressions where the old text was better: ui.audiencesEyebrow and the Wilsons Prom tip.
criticalIssues: Not caused by this diff, but it surfaces on merge: the branch was cut from f0e8041, before main added GA4 (652ce5f, f32829e, e3b8624). Against origin/main's en.json, the Italian privacy page is stale. It has 6 sections against 7 in English: the whole 'Website analytics' section (GA4 processing, Google Ireland, the _ga/_ga_ cookies with 13-month lifetime, consent in the EEA/UK/CH, 14-month retention) is missing. As a result pages.privacy.sections[4]/[5] are shifted by one section against the English keys. pages.privacy.effective still reads 'In vigore dal 12 agosto 2026' (English: 19 October 2026). The consent.* keys (accept, decline, label, learnMore, message, privacyChoices) do not exist in it.json on main or on this branch. Italian visitors are EEA users who get the consent banner, so the Italian privacy policy should disclose GA4 before or with this merge. Fix: rebase the branch onto main, then translate the GA4 section, the new effective date and the consent.* keys.

pages.privacy.sections[3].paragraphs[1] keeps 'AussieCamps non usa tracker pubblicitari su questo sito.', which matched the English at the merge base. On main that sentence has moved into the new GA4 section, so after the rebase it must be re-aligned.
